title: Feature Documentation - 四阶段功能规格文档

requirements: Create 1 file: docs/features/README.md (功能总览，列出 4 个阶段的功能清单，~60-80 lines)
Create 1 file: docs/features/phase1-playback.md (Phase 1 已实现功能文档，~80-100 lines)
Create 1 file: docs/features/phase2-usability.md (Phase 2 功能规格，~200-250 lines)
Create 1 file: docs/features/phase3-polish.md (Phase 3 功能规格，~100-120 lines)
Create 1 file: docs/features/phase4-advanced.md (Phase 4 功能规格，~100-120 lines)
phase1-playback.md must document 8 已完成功能 from Phase 1 checklist
phase2-usability.md must specify 11 功能模块: [后台播放, 主导航, 艺术家浏览, 专辑浏览, 专辑详情, 搜索, 全屏播放, 播放队列, 播放列表, 收藏, 设置]
phase3-polish.md must specify 6 功能: [完整播放页, 深色/浅色主题, 封面取色, 歌词, 动画, 响应式布局]
phase4-advanced.md must specify 7 功能: [离线缓存, 收藏, scrobble, 音质选择, 均衡器, 快捷键, 多服务器]
acceptance: 5 files created: verify by ls docs/features/*.md | wc -l = 5
phase1-playback.md documents 8 features: verify by grep -c '^### ' docs/features/phase1-playback.md >= 8
phase2-usability.md documents 11 modules: verify by grep -c '^### ' docs/features/phase2-usability.md >= 11
phase3-polish.md documents 6 features: verify by grep -c '^### ' docs/features/phase3-polish.md >= 6
phase4-advanced.md documents 7 features: verify by grep -c '^### ' docs/features/phase4-advanced.md >= 7
Each feature spec includes: 目标, 关键文件, API接口, 交互流程: verify by grep -c '目标\|关键文件' docs/features/phase2-usability.md >= 10
